GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

2. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.

3. When practising Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.

4. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Good night

5. When practising Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.

8. When practising Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading.

9. When practising Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.

11. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.

12. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Wasser
   D. Buch

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
